name: toggle
useFor: Use for an on or off option that acts at once in a toolbar (show live routes only, pin a merchant). Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label. Use outline when the toggle sits among white keys.
constraints: A toggle for a setting saved later (use Switch or Checkbox)
Blue fill for the pressed state
An icon that moves when pressed
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the keys and the header's trays)
title: Toggle
description: A 34px key that stays pressed: a quiet label on the wash, or a white key that lights blue.
